title: A survey on permutable transcendental entire functions and their dynamics
summary: In this paper, we survey important results on the dynamics of permutable transcendental entire functions from 1958 to 2025. We have discussed the forms of transcendental entire functions that could be permutable. We have also discussed the dynamical properties of permutable entire functions. For instance, how the Fatou and Julia sets are related. We have also considered the relation of the subsets which are classified based on the dynamics of the orbit of a point in the complex plane. They are the filled Julia set $K(f)$ (set of points whose orbits remain bounded), the escaping set $I(f)$…
